_comment: P4-T5 surface registry — one row per reporting surface. Deploy gates: publish-board-portal.yml (kgs) and validate-dashboard.yml (kenetik-dashboards) fail the build if a deployed HTML is not registered here with status 'deployed'. The kenetik-dashboards copy of this file is a pure sync target (sync-website-state-to-dashboards.yml); edit only in kgs architecture/reporting/.

surfaces.name: Board Intelligence Portal
surfaces.purpose: Board/investor-facing intelligence: financials, cohorts, subscriptions, wholesale (incl. AR), creators, milestones.

surfaces.name: Tracker Scoreboard
surfaces.purpose: Weekly-review scoreboard: L1-L3 metric trajectories vs targets, ChangeSet activity, wholesale detail.

surfaces.name: Ops Dashboard
surfaces.purpose: Daily operational surface: paid media (P3-T1 rescue incl. fatigue flags), VoC, subscriptions, Amazon honest-blank.
surfaces.refresh_cadence: daily (exec BI chain ~6:00 ET) + daily 11:30 UTC republish

surfaces.name: Weekly Trends
surfaces.purpose: ISO-week medians of the daily digest metrics (P3-T3/T4); 26-week rolling window.

surfaces.name: Marketing Dashboard (v2, consolidated)
surfaces.purpose: Campaign/content/task view for the marketing team (BIG CAMPAIGNS + content calendar + team tasks + retail).
surfaces.refresh_cadence: daily (Task 2a writes calendar; team edits ad hoc) + daily republish
surfaces.note: P4-T4 investigation open: overlap with marketing-calendar-dashboard.html — merge recommendation with Devon

surfaces.name: Marketing Calendar Dashboard
surfaces.purpose: Calendar-first view of parent campaigns + sub-beats; carries embedded JSON snapshot (1.5 MB).
surfaces.refresh_cadence: daily republish; embedded snapshot updates on regeneration only
surfaces.note: P4-T4 investigation open: merge/externalize-embedded-JSON recommendation with Devon

surfaces.name: KGS System Map
surfaces.purpose: Static visual map of the KGS pipeline/architecture for orientation.

surfaces.name: Wholesale Admin (input app)
surfaces.purpose: Authed input app for wholesale account edits; writes to Supabase (read-only portal rule does not apply).

surfaces.name: Dept Dashboards (redirect stub)
surfaces.purpose: Redirect stub to scoreboard.html; retired from the deploy in P2-T5.

surfaces.name: Connections Tracker
surfaces.purpose: Ad-hoc relationship/connections tracker prototype; never wired into the deploy.

surfaces.name: Creator Capacity Planner
surfaces.purpose: Modash-fed creator capacity planning prototype; never wired into the deploy.

surfaces.name: KGS Virtual Team Dashboard
surfaces.purpose: Build-state view of the 12 roles / 98 processes in the KGS Virtual Team spec.
data_sources: system-state.json (pure sync target from kgs — P4-T1)

surfaces.name: ChangeSet Dashboard
surfaces.purpose: ChangeSet pipeline view: tracker statuses, work queue, impact rollup (D3 rewrite, D4-gated).

surfaces.name: Website Experiment Dashboard
surfaces.purpose: Auto-optimize experiment surfaces: state, clarity snapshots, website-state trends.

surfaces.name: Kenetik Network Viewer
surfaces.purpose: Mermaid network diagrams of KGS roles/processes (network-diagrams/*.mermaid).
surfaces.note: Devon to decide retirement; still deployed until then, so it must stay registered
